column1: # eng_for_kor item 3. Yes/no questions take the polite question ending -나요?/-ㄹ까요? (in 해요 form a statement and a question
# are the same words, so a "?" alone leaves two answers); wh-questions keep 해요 + "?" (the wh-word already makes the question).
# Rows built from a whole seed take the seed's own Korean.
